title: Practice 6: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мэри вышла за ___ (шотландец, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **шотландец → шотландца** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: шотландц- + -а.  Declension: sg. шотландец · шотландца · шотландцу · шотландца · шотландцем · шотландце; pl. шотландцы · шотландцев · шотландцам · шотландцев · шотландцами · шотландцах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «Certain masculine nouns have the vowels е or о only in the nominative singular (and in the accusative if inanimate): отец — отца, американец — американца, кусок — куска, звонок — звонка.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Под ___ (знамя, acc. sg.), слушай, на кра-ул!
exercises.why: **знамя → знамя** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя. Declines like DLI's имя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. знамя · знамени · знамени · знамя · знаменем · знамени; pl. знамёна · знамён · знамёнам · знамёна · знамёнами · знамёнах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: За ___ (спрос, acc. sg.) денег не берут.
exercises.why: **спрос → спрос** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. спрос · спроса · спросу · спрос · спросом · спросе; pl. спросы · спросов · спросам · спросы · спросами · спросах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Поезд огненной лентой ныряет под ___ (чёрный свод, acc. sg.) подземелья.
exercises.why: **свод → свод** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **чёрный → черный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with свод). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. свод · свода · своду · свод · сводом · своде; pl. своды · сводов · сводам · своды · сводами · сводах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том проклял себя за ___ (легкомысленность, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom cursed himself for his carelessness.
exercises.why: **легкомысленность → легкомысленность** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. легкомысленность · легкомысленности · легкомысленности · легкомысленность · легкомысленностью · легкомысленности; pl. легкомысленности · легкомысленностей · легкомысленностям · легкомысленности · легкомысленностями · легкомысленностях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Давайте пересядем за ___ (тот стол, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Let's move over to that table.
exercises.why: **стол → стол** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **тот → тот** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with стол). «тот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): тот · того · тому · тот (inan.) / того (anim.) · тем · том.  Declension: sg. стол · стола · столу · стол · столом · столе; pl. столы · столов · столам · столы · столами · столах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Смыл он несколько сажи — оказалось под ___ (нея, acc. sg.) скуластое медно-красное лицо.
exercises.why: **нея → нею** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. нея · неи · нее · нею · неей · нее; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. exercises.q: Немцы выступают за ___ (жёсткая экономия, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The Germans are in favor of austerity.
exercises.why: **экономия → экономию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия. Declines like DLI's армия — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. армию). Ending -ая → -ую.
